# The error paths of internal/api/notifications that answer without a code of the
# catalog. This list only shrinks: give a path a code, remove its line and
# lower the limit. A new error path never goes on this list.
limit 22
Handler.writeError: errorResponse{}
badRequest: statusError{}
classify: AsType[*idempotent.Error]
classify: AsType[*statusError]
classify: idempotency.ErrLost
classifyAuth: default
classifyAuth: identity.ErrRateLimited
classifyAuth: identity.ErrUnauthenticated
classifyNamespace: default
classifyNamespace: maintenance.ErrInMaintenance
classifyNamespace: namespace.ErrFenced
classifyNamespace: namespace.ErrInvalidName
classifyNamespace: namespace.ErrNotFound
classifyNamespace: namespace.ErrNotHome
classifySink: default
classifySink: notify.ErrConflict
classifySink: notify.ErrInvalid
classifySink: notify.ErrNoURL
classifySink: notify.ErrNotFound
classifySink: sinks.ErrNoSender
classifySink: sinks.ErrPlatformHost
